# Cubiomes upstream information

- Upstream repository: https://github.com/Cubitect/cubiomes
- Imported revision: `e61f90580cbdd883214a8054670dacae655e59c0`
- Revision date: 2024-11-10
- License: MIT; see `LICENSE`

Cubiomes provides Minecraft Java Edition biome and structure
generation logic used by the YOCSOW seed finder.

The source is vendored to keep Linux, Windows, CI, and release builds
reproducible without requiring Git submodules.

Upstream files should only be changed as part of an explicit Cubiomes
version update.
